name: Add Member
description: Pick people for a project, and watch their faces fly into the stack.

name: Balance Card
description: A counting balance, a liquid currency selector and a drawer that settles.

name: Calendar
description: A month card where the selected day glides from date to date.

name: Add To Cart
description: A product card that is only a photo until you open it.

name: Chat Room
description: A stack of faces that morphs into a voice chat card, and back.

name: Chips
description: A selection list of 3D chips that press into the surface.

name: Copy Paste Pad
description: A 3-D aluminium macro pad whose ⌘C and ⌘V copy and paste the theme.

name: Desk Computer
description: A late-90s desk computer in true isometric that you can actually use.

name: Dynamic Drop Zone
description: A file drop zone that turns into a magnetic black hole.

name: File Box
description: A cardboard file box whose folders lift out by their tabs.

name: Joystick
description: A pixel-art arcade stick you can grab, push to the gate and let snap back.

name: Lamp Switch
description: A hanging ceramic lamp that swings on a cord and toggles with a liquid switch.

name: Liquid Tabs
description: A notifications card whose active tab is liquid, flowing from tab to tab.

name: Liquid Voice
description: A voice-input pill of real liquid glass that stretches into a recorder.

name: Magnify
description: A type specimen you inspect with a real magnifying glass.

name: Egg OTP
description: A one-time-code field made of eggs that crack on a wrong code.

name: Presence Cards
description: Two cards on a shared canvas, worked on live by four people at once.

name: Progress Image
description: A rollout card whose photograph is the progress bar.

name: Prompt Composer
description: An assistant's field with its quick actions fanned out behind it.

name: Reader Card
description: A story card that scrolls in place and morphs into a liquid-glass reader.

name: Recorder
description: A voice recorder with a waveform that scrolls under the playhead.

name: Search Card
description: A centred search bar that rises and morphs open into a card of recent searches.

name: Selection List
description: A single-choice list whose halves snap together like magnets.

name: Count down
description: A session broken into blocks, counting down in real time.

name: Swap Card
description: A token swap card where every number rolls and the button is liquid.

name: Task Card
description: A task with subtasks on a connector tree, progress, priority and status.

name: Taxi
description: Hail a cab in one tap, and ride the whole trip on one card.

name: Theme Switch
description: A theme toggle that rains, drips or sets off fireworks to change the theme.

name: Thermal Dial
description: A thermal dial that undulates with heat and rolls through the seasons.

name: Weather
description: A weather square that opens out into a five-day forecast.

name: CareMetric Footer
description: Footer block. Green link columns over a giant, bleeding mark.

name: Contact Form
description: Contact block. Black tiles, a reaching hand and a real form.

name: Halo Sign In
description: Auth block. A soft card in a tray, its mark in turning dots.

name: Luna Hero
description: Hero Section block. Pixel storefront hero with a floating mega menu.

name: Odometer Pricing
description: Pricing block. Prices roll like an odometer on billing.

name: Orbit Hero
description: Hero Section block. Space hero with a live, turning WebGL Earth.

name: iPartyLabs Hero
description: Hero Section block. A headline floating in a field of party photos.

name: Pixelkit Sign In
description: Auth block. A lime tile, three providers and a magic link.

name: Smart Pricing
description: Pricing block. Lime plans with a yearly switch and rolling prices.

name: Storybook Hero
description: Hero Section block. A parchment hero with a glowing cottage in an arch.

name: Synais Footer
description: Footer block. Dark link columns over a giant cream wordmark.
